datasheet.revision_or_date: AP3156 Rev. 1, September 2009 (diodes.com copy identical in text to LCSC C443652 copy)

ratings.cite: AP3156 datasheet (Diodes, Rev. 1, Sept 2009) p.4 Absolute Maximum Ratings
ratings.design: VSYS up to ~5.7 V transient on hot plug (design.py R47 comment); ~4.7-5.0 V steady from USB

ratings.cite: AP3156 datasheet (Diodes, Rev. 1, Sept 2009) p.4 Recommended Operating Conditions
ratings.design: VSYS 3.0-4.2 V on cell, ~4.7 V on USB, ~5.7 V transient
ratings.note: Transient above 5.5 V recommended max (not damaging per abs max). Below 2.7 V UVLO disables the part.

ratings.design: 3V3 GPIO; 3V3 is derived from VSYS by LDO so SDI <= VSYS
6 x 20 mA = 120 mA (20 mA mode, default)
ratings.note: 25 mA mode = 150 mA = at limit and over the panel's 120 mA

ratings.cite: AP3156 datasheet (Diodes, Rev. 1, Sept 2009) p.1, p.9
ratings.design: C31 1u VSYS, C32 1u LED_A_DRV, C33 1u C1P-C1N, C36 1u C2P-C2N

pins.requirement: Sink for an LED cathode; if unused tie to VOUT. All six sinks used here (D4-D6 paralleled on LED_K2)
pins.cite: AP3156 datasheet (Diodes, Rev. 1, Sept 2009) p.3 Pin Descriptions
pins.quote: Current Sink Input #6. Connected to VOUT when un-used.
pins.issue: Three sinks paralleled per panel cathode pin (datasheet: 'current sinks may be operated individually or in parallel'). 20 mA mode => 60 mA per cathode pin, 120 mA total = panel's 120 mA typ. Do NOT use 25 mA mode at code 1 (150 mA total).

pins.requirement: 1-wire control. Held LOW > TOFF(max)=256 us = shutdown (<1 uA); rising edge re-enables. Idle HIGH when not commanding. VIL<=0.4 V, VIH>=1.4 V, leakage +/-1 uA; must stay <= VIN+0.3 V
pins.cite: AP3156 datasheet (Diodes, Rev. 1, Sept 2009) p.3 Pin Descriptions; p.5 Elec. Char. (SDI); p.11 SDI Command Timing; p.4 Abs Max VSDI
pins.quote: If at any time the SDI pin is held Low for longer than the maximum chip disable time TOFF(max), then the AP3156 will be turned off and enters the shutdown mode.
pins.issue: OK: R31 100k to GND holds SDI low = shutdown until firmware drives it high (matches datasheet). Datasheet does not state the current level the part comes up at when first enabled (only Soft Reset = 0 mA is defined): UNKNOWN, firmware should program it explicitly.
